abstract: We report on a case of primary pericardial teratoma detected in a 29-week-old fetus. Due to cardiac decompensation, pericardiocentesis was performed at 33 weeks of gestation, and surgical excision of the tumor was indicated shortly after birth. The present report draws attention to the impact of fetal echocardiography on perinatal management.
abstract_ja: 29週の胎児で発見された原発性心膜奇形腫の症例を報告する。心不全の進行のため、妊娠33週で心嚢穿刺を施行し、出生直後に外科的切除を行った。本報告は、胎児心エコーが周産期管理に与える影響に注目している。
